LanguageData.MooGirl_ArmorHelmetRecon.label: Mugirl Recon Helmet "Énigme de l'Ombre du Papillon"
LanguageData.MooGirl_ArmorHelmetRecon.description: "Vache Rousse" presents a lightweight streamlined helmet, with a dusky pink fabric lining for comfort.\nThis piece represents a perfect fusion of tactical functionality and aesthetic appeal.\nA bow, glimpsed in the darkness, blooms with a lethal allure.
LanguageData.MooGirl_BunnyGirlHeaddress.label: Mugirl Bunny Girl Headdress "Velours Nocturne Envoûtant"
LanguageData.MooGirl_BunnyGirlHeaddress.description: "Vache Rousse" presents its signature black short-pile long ear headdress.\nThe lustrous material reflects a playful yet sensual charm.\nThese long ears sway freely with song and dance, capturing a moment of coquettish allure amidst shimmering lights and flowing wine.
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicRecon.label: Mugirl Tactical Goggles
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_MechanicRecon.description: Tactical goggles of the information age. Their metal construction provides a small amount of additional protection.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Sunglasses.label: Mugirl Sunglasses "Reflet Néon Illusoire"
LanguageData.MooGirl_Sunglasses.description: "Vache Rousse" presents retro round-frame pinch-on sunglasses, petite yet unable to conceal expressive glances.\nThey maintain a fashionable poise while shielding against glare, an essential urban accessory for the discerning individual.
